# AI kit

`game.ai` reads and changes how pawns decide what to do: work givers and their order, think trees, duties, lords, and what pathfinding costs. The kit is Experimental in the [stability tiers](stability.md). Functions that act on one pawn take the pawn first.

Work givers decide which jobs a pawn looks for inside a work type, in priority order. `think_insert` and `think_remove` change the think tree that every pawn of a kind shares, so a change applies to all of them at once and stays until the game restarts. Insert only node classes that have a parameterless constructor.

```lua
-- Cleaning before hauling for everyone
for _, g in ipairs(game.ai.work_givers("Hauling")) do
  game.ai.set_work_giver_priority(g.def, g.priority - 5)
end

-- Stop colonists wandering when idle
game.ai.think_remove("Humanlike", "JobGiver_WanderColony")
```

## Functions

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `game.ai.work_givers` | `work_type?` | `RimWorkGiverInfo[]` | Every work giver, optionally only one work type. |
| `game.ai.set_work_giver_priority` | `def, priority` | `integer` | Reorders a work giver inside its work type. Higher runs first. |
| `game.ai.work_types` |  | `RimWorkTypeInfo[]` | Work types with their givers in priority order. |
| `game.ai.think_trees` |  | `string[]` | Every think tree def name. |
| `game.ai.think_nodes` | `def` | `RimThinkNode[]` | A think tree flattened depth first, with node class names. |
| `game.ai.think_remove` | `def, class` | `integer` | Removes every node of a class from a think tree. Returns how many. |
| `game.ai.think_insert` | `def, class, parent?, index?` | `boolean` | Adds a node of a class (it needs a parameterless constructor) under a parent node class, first by default. |
| `game.ai.duty_defs` |  | `string[]` | Every duty def name. |
| `game.ai.lord_make` | `map, opts` | `boolean` | Puts pawns under a new lord running ExitMap, ExitMapBest, DefendPoint or a Lua class. |
| `game.ai.duty` | `pawn` | `RimDuty?` | The pawn's current duty. |
| `game.ai.set_duty` | `pawn, def, x?, z?` | `boolean` | Gives the pawn a duty, with an optional cell focus, and interrupts its job. |
| `game.ai.lord_of` | `pawn` | `RimLordOf?` | The lord the pawn belongs to. |
| `game.ai.remove_from_lord` | `pawn` | `boolean` | Takes the pawn out of its lord. |
| `game.ai.path_cost` | `pawn, x, z` | `integer` | What the pawn's pathfinding thinks a cell costs. |
| `game.ai.danger` | `pawn, x, z` | `string` | Danger of a cell for this pawn: None, Some or Deadly. |
| `game.ai.max_danger` | `pawn` | `string` | The highest danger this pawn will path through. |
